meta.title: Hindsight memory tuning
meta.description: Use /hindsight to see whether Hindsight project memory is reachable, how much it adds per turn, and which tuning is active. The plugin caps what one turn can receive (maxInjectTokens, default 3000) and writes a lean profile into ~/.hindsight/coding-agent.json: pages-first injection, per-source observation scopes, a 7-second inject deadline and a 2000-token recall ceiling. It fills only absent keys unless overwrite is requested and backs the file up first; /hindsight revert removes only the keys it wrote, and disabling the bundle does not undo them. status and probe make one GET request to the configured Hindsight endpoint; the plugin's own state and journal live under ~/.dsh/storages/dsh-hindsight-tuner. Memory itself comes from @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents; without it the plugin reports that the memory layer is not installed.
